notes: Evaluates fail-closed implementation prerequisites: empty/unrecognized tier refusal, Gate 1 rulings verification (--rulings), Low-tier ac-classify.sh placeholder rejection, §14 Integration-Branch Enforcement fail-closed check, atomic review_started_at preservation, and stage-effort.sh dual-path calculation.

evals.name: empty-tier-fails-closed
evals.expected_output: Halts fail-closed citing specs/ACME-200/metadata.yaml and stating tier cannot be resolved. Never defaults to Low.
assertions: Halts immediately when tier is empty or missing
Does NOT default empty tier to Low
Performs zero status mutations or branch creations before halting

evals.name: low-tier-placeholder-ac-halt
evals.prompt: Implement Low-tier ticket whose problem.md only contains the unmodified template Acceptance Criteria bullets.
evals.expected_output: Runs ac-classify.sh, observes exit 1 (verdict=placeholder-only), emits implement.prerequisites.ac_placeholder_only, and halts without writes or fallback grep.
assertions: Does NOT fall back to naive grep

evals.name: preserves-existing-review-started-at
evals.prompt: Re-run Step 5 transition to in-review on a second cycle where review_started_at already has an earlier UTC timestamp.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing review_started_at byte-for-byte, computes implementation stage_effort via stage-effort.sh (0m or 15m multiple), updates actual_effort, and projects via the bound tracker skill.
assertions: Uses stage-effort.sh supporting ci-templates/ and processes/ci-templates/ paths
Verifies stage effort is 0m or an exact multiple of 15 minutes
